extends Node3D
## Production pilot presentation recovered from VS-5 combat and the locomotion
## lab. Reads PlayerAvatar only; it owns no gameplay truth.

const ModelLib := preload("res://combat/src/visuals/model_lib.gd")
const PilotNativeAnim := preload("res://combat/src/pilot/pilot_native_anim.gd")

const PILOT_COLOR := Color(0.42, 0.60, 0.72)
const DARK := Color(0.12, 0.14, 0.17)
const AMBER := Color(1.0, 0.69, 0.0)

# Shared camera geometry. PlayerAvatar reconstructs the same ray on the host so
# authoritative packed-crowd hits stay aligned with the screen-center crosshair
# without making gameplay depend on this presentation node.
const CAMERA_PIVOT_HEIGHT := 1.58
const CAMERA_SHOULDER_X := 0.48
const CAMERA_FREE_LENGTH := 4.0
const CAMERA_AIM_LENGTH := 2.35
const CAMERA_MARGIN := 0.25

var local_view := false
var camera: Camera3D = null
var _pivot: Node3D = null
var _arm: SpringArm3D = null
var _pack: MeshInstance3D = null
var _crosshair: ColorRect = null
var _dmg_flash: ColorRect = null
var _native: Node3D = null
var _visual_root: Node3D = null
var _left_leg: Node3D = null
var _right_leg: Node3D = null
var _left_arm: Node3D = null
var _right_arm: Node3D = null
var _anim_t := 0.0


func setup(body_rid: RID, p_local_view: bool) -> void:
	local_view = p_local_view
	if _arm != null:
		_arm.add_excluded_object(body_rid)
	set_local_camera_active(local_view)


func _ready() -> void:
	_visual_root = Node3D.new()
	_visual_root.name = "PilotVisual"
	add_child(_visual_root)

	_native = PilotNativeAnim.new()
	_native.name = "NativeAnimationBackend"
	_visual_root.add_child(_native)
	var animated: bool = bool(_native.try_setup())
	if not animated:
		if not _attach_synty_static():
			_build_biped_fallback()

	_build_weapon()
	_build_pack()
	_build_camera()
	if local_view:
		_build_screen_feedback()


func _attach_synty_static() -> bool:
	var path := ModelLib.DIR + "characters.fbx"
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(path):
		return false
	var ps := load(path)
	if ps == null or not (ps is PackedScene):
		return false
	var inst := (ps as PackedScene).instantiate()
	if inst == null or not (inst is Node3D):
		return false
	var n := inst as Node3D
	for mi in n.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
		var mesh_instance := mi as MeshInstance3D
		if mesh_instance.name.findn("Female") >= 0:
			mesh_instance.visible = false
	_visual_root.add_child(n)
	n.rotation.y = PI
	var aabb := ModelLib._merged_aabb(n)
	if aabb.size.y > 0.01:
		var k := 1.8 / aabb.size.y
		n.scale = Vector3.ONE * k
		n.position.y = -aabb.position.y * k
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = PILOT_COLOR
	mat.roughness = 0.75
	ModelLib._paint(n, mat)
	return true


func _piece(parent: Node3D, name_v: String, size_v: Vector3, pos: Vector3,
		color: Color) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.name = name_v
	var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	mesh.size = size_v
	mi.mesh = mesh
	mi.position = pos
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mat.roughness = 0.8
	mi.material_override = mat
	parent.add_child(mi)
	return mi


func _build_biped_fallback() -> void:
	# Deliberately humanoid, never a capsule: clean source checkout must not
	# silently regress to the VS-2 oval.
	var body := Node3D.new()
	body.name = "BipedFallback"
	_visual_root.add_child(body)
	_piece(body, "Torso", Vector3(0.62, 0.72, 0.34), Vector3(0, 1.18, 0), PILOT_COLOR)
	_piece(body, "Pelvis", Vector3(0.48, 0.28, 0.32), Vector3(0, 0.74, 0), DARK)
	var head := MeshInstance3D.new()
	head.name = "Head"
	var sphere := SphereMesh.new()
	sphere.radius = 0.19
	sphere.height = 0.38
	head.mesh = sphere
	head.position = Vector3(0, 1.72, 0)
	var hm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	hm.albedo_color = Color(0.58, 0.66, 0.70)
	head.material_override = hm
	body.add_child(head)

	_left_leg = Node3D.new()
	_right_leg = Node3D.new()
	_left_arm = Node3D.new()
	_right_arm = Node3D.new()
	_left_leg.position = Vector3(-0.16, 0.68, 0)
	_right_leg.position = Vector3(0.16, 0.68, 0)
	_left_arm.position = Vector3(-0.42, 1.42, 0)
	_right_arm.position = Vector3(0.42, 1.42, 0)
	for limb in [_left_leg, _right_leg, _left_arm, _right_arm]:
		body.add_child(limb)
	_piece(_left_leg, "LegL", Vector3(0.20, 0.72, 0.22), Vector3(0, -0.34, 0), DARK)
	_piece(_right_leg, "LegR", Vector3(0.20, 0.72, 0.22), Vector3(0, -0.34, 0), DARK)
	_piece(_left_arm, "ArmL", Vector3(0.16, 0.62, 0.18), Vector3(0, -0.27, 0), PILOT_COLOR)
	_piece(_right_arm, "ArmR", Vector3(0.16, 0.62, 0.18), Vector3(0, -0.27, 0), PILOT_COLOR)


func _build_weapon() -> void:
	var gun := Node3D.new()
	gun.name = "Rifle"
	_visual_root.add_child(gun)
	var mounted := false
	for file in ["rifle.fbx", "SM_Wep_PowerRifle_01.fbx", "SM_Wep_AssaultRifle_01.fbx"]:
		if ResourceLoader.exists(ModelLib.DIR + file):
			mounted = ModelLib.attach_sized(gun, file, DARK, Vector3(0.36, 1.20, -0.35), 0.95)
			if mounted:
				break
	if not mounted:
		_piece(gun, "RifleFallback", Vector3(0.14, 0.14, 0.86),
			Vector3(0.34, 1.22, -0.48), DARK)


func _build_pack() -> void:
	_pack = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var pb := BoxMesh.new()
	pb.size = Vector3(0.42, 0.42, 0.26)
	var pm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	pm.albedo_color = Color(0.20, 0.78, 0.38)
	pm.emission_enabled = true
	pm.emission = Color(0.03, 0.22, 0.09)
	_pack.mesh = pb
	_pack.material_override = pm
	_pack.position = Vector3(0.0, 1.15, 0.38)
	_pack.visible = false
	_visual_root.add_child(_pack)


func _build_camera() -> void:
	_pivot = Node3D.new()
	_pivot.position = Vector3(0.0, CAMERA_PIVOT_HEIGHT, 0.0)
	add_child(_pivot)
	_arm = SpringArm3D.new()
	_arm.spring_length = CAMERA_FREE_LENGTH
	_arm.margin = CAMERA_MARGIN
	_arm.position = Vector3(CAMERA_SHOULDER_X, 0.0, 0.0)
	_arm.collision_mask = 1
	_pivot.add_child(_arm)
	camera = Camera3D.new()
	camera.fov = 75.0
	camera.near = 0.08
	camera.current = false
	_arm.add_child(camera)


func _build_screen_feedback() -> void:
	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	add_child(layer)
	_crosshair = ColorRect.new()
	_crosshair.color = AMBER
	_crosshair.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_crosshair.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
	_crosshair.position = Vector2(-2, -2)
	_crosshair.size = Vector2(4, 4)
	layer.add_child(_crosshair)
	_dmg_flash = ColorRect.new()
	_dmg_flash.color = Color(0.90, 0.12, 0.08, 0.0)
	_dmg_flash.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_dmg_flash.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	layer.add_child(_dmg_flash)


func set_local_camera_active(on: bool) -> void:
	if camera != null:
		camera.current = local_view and on
	if _crosshair != null:
		_crosshair.visible = local_view and on


func sync_from_avatar(body: PlayerAvatar, delta: float) -> void:
	if _pivot == null or body.pilot_input == null:
		return
	# Player body can now face travel independently in free mode. Keep the
	# presentation camera on the replicated absolute look yaw by compensating
	# for the parent's rollback-synchronized body rotation.
	_pivot.rotation.y = wrapf(body.pilot_input.look_yaw - body.rotation.y, -PI, PI)
	_pivot.rotation.x = body.pilot_input.look_pitch
	var aim := body.pilot_input.aiming
	_arm.spring_length = lerpf(_arm.spring_length,
		CAMERA_AIM_LENGTH if aim else CAMERA_FREE_LENGTH, minf(delta * 12.0, 1.0))
	camera.fov = lerpf(camera.fov, 62.0 if aim else 75.0, minf(delta * 12.0, 1.0))
	if _native != null:
		_native.sync(body.velocity, body.grounded, delta)
	_sync_fallback_walk(body.velocity, delta)


func _sync_fallback_walk(velocity: Vector3, delta: float) -> void:
	if _left_leg == null:
		return
	var speed := Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z).length()
	_anim_t += delta * maxf(speed, 0.5) * 1.8
	var amount := clampf(speed / 7.5, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.55
	var swing := sin(_anim_t) * amount
	_left_leg.rotation.x = swing
	_right_leg.rotation.x = -swing
	_left_arm.rotation.x = -swing * 0.6
	_right_arm.rotation.x = swing * 0.6


func damage_flash() -> void:
	if _dmg_flash == null:
		return
	_dmg_flash.color = Color(0.90, 0.12, 0.08, 0.26)
	Fx.play_sfx(self, Fx.thud_stream(), -10.0, 0.82)
	get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout.connect(func():
		if is_instance_valid(_dmg_flash):
			_dmg_flash.color = Color(0.90, 0.12, 0.08, 0.0))


func shot_audio(hit: bool, weakpoint: bool = false) -> void:
	# Reuse the proven procedural mech SFX family; no licensed audio dependency.
	# Local fire stays immediate/non-spatial, remote pilot shots use a short 3D
	# cue so co-op preserves ownership without making every rifle sound local.
	if local_view:
		Fx.play_sfx(self, Fx.shot_stream(), -7.0, 1.12)
	else:
		_play_world_sfx(Fx.shot_stream(), -10.0, 1.04)
	if local_view and hit:
		Fx.play_sfx(self, Fx.zap_stream() if weakpoint else Fx.thud_stream(),
			-13.0 if weakpoint else -15.0, 1.18 if weakpoint else 1.0)


func _play_world_sfx(stream: AudioStream, volume_db: float, pitch: float) -> void:
	if stream == null or not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var p := AudioStreamPlayer3D.new()
	p.stream = stream
	p.volume_db = volume_db
	p.pitch_scale = pitch
	p.max_distance = 45.0
	add_child(p)
	p.play()
	p.finished.connect(p.queue_free)


func hit_feedback(weakpoint: bool = false) -> void:
	if _crosshair == null:
		return
	_crosshair.color = Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.70) if weakpoint else Color(0.24, 0.86, 0.55)
	get_tree().create_timer(0.09).timeout.connect(func():
		if is_instance_valid(_crosshair):
			_crosshair.color = AMBER)


func aim_ray() -> Array:
	if camera == null:
		return [global_position + Vector3.UP * 1.55, -global_basis.z]
	var t := camera.global_transform
	return [t.origin, -t.basis.z]


func muzzle_pos() -> Vector3:
	return to_global(Vector3(0.34, 1.22, -0.95))


func tracer(from: Vector3, to: Vector3) -> void:
	if from.distance_to(to) < 0.25 or not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
	cyl.top_radius = 0.018
	cyl.bottom_radius = 0.018
	cyl.height = from.distance_to(to)
	mi.mesh = cyl
	mi.position = (from + to) * 0.5
	var dir := from.direction_to(to)
	mi.look_at(to, Vector3.UP if absf(dir.dot(Vector3.UP)) < 0.99 else Vector3.RIGHT)
	mi.rotate_object_local(Vector3.RIGHT, PI * 0.5)
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = Color(1.0, 0.84, 0.38)
	mat.emission_enabled = true
	mat.emission = Color(1.0, 0.66, 0.15)
	mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.2
	mi.material_override = mat
	var root := get_tree().current_scene
	if root == null:
		return
	root.add_child(mi)
	get_tree().create_timer(0.055).timeout.connect(mi.queue_free)

class_name OperationHud
extends CanvasLayer
## Player-facing operation HUD. Consumes only OperationPresentationAdapter;
## gameplay authority and MissionKernel internals stay outside this layer.

const AMBER := Color(1.0, 0.69, 0.0)
const AMBER_DIM := Color(0.48, 0.31, 0.0)
const OK := Color(0.24, 0.86, 0.55)
const ALERT := Color(1.0, 0.31, 0.18)
const INFO := Color(0.22, 0.78, 0.85)
const BG := Color(0.025, 0.02, 0.015, 0.86)

var adapter: OperationPresentationAdapter = null
var _root: Control
var _player: Label
var _wave: Label
var _objective: Label
var _threat: Label
var _systems: Label
var _toast: Label
var _minimap: OperationMinimap
var _interwave: PanelContainer
var _interwave_text: Label
var _result: PanelContainer
var _result_text: Label
var _toast_until_ms := 0


func setup(p_adapter: OperationPresentationAdapter) -> void:
	adapter = p_adapter
	if adapter != null:
		if not adapter.snapshot_changed.is_connected(_on_snapshot):
			adapter.snapshot_changed.connect(_on_snapshot)
		if not adapter.gameplay_event.is_connected(_on_gameplay_event):
			adapter.gameplay_event.connect(_on_gameplay_event)
		_on_snapshot(adapter.snapshot())


func _ready() -> void:
	_root = Control.new()
	_root.name = "OperationHudRoot"
	_root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(_root)

	_player = _panel_label("PilotPanel", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
		Vector4(20, 20, 340, 118), 18, AMBER)
	_wave = _panel_label("WavePanel", 0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0,
		Vector4(-160, 20, 160, 92), 22, AMBER)
	_objective = _panel_label("ObjectivePanel", 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0,
		Vector4(-360, 20, -20, 138), 20, INFO)
	_threat = _panel_label("ThreatPanel", 0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0,
		Vector4(-280, 124, 280, 182), 18, ALERT)
	_systems = _panel_label("SystemsPanel", 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0,
		Vector4(-390, -164, -20, -20), 18, AMBER)

	_minimap = OperationMinimap.new()
	_minimap.name = "OperationMinimap"
	_minimap.anchor_left = 0.0
	_minimap.anchor_top = 1.0
	_minimap.anchor_right = 0.0
	_minimap.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	_minimap.offset_left = 20
	_minimap.offset_top = -250
	_minimap.offset_right = 250
	_minimap.offset_bottom = -20
	_root.add_child(_minimap)

	_toast = Label.new()
	_toast.name = "GameplayToast"
	_toast.anchor_left = 0.5
	_toast.anchor_right = 0.5
	_toast.offset_left = -420
	_toast.offset_right = 420
	_toast.offset_top = 194
	_toast.offset_bottom = 236
	_toast.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_toast.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	_toast.add_theme_color_override("font_color", AMBER)
	_toast.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_root.add_child(_toast)

	_interwave = _center_overlay("InterWave", Vector2(620, 250), AMBER)
	_interwave_text = _overlay_label(_interwave, 22)
	_result = _center_overlay("Result", Vector2(620, 280), INFO)
	_result_text = _overlay_label(_result, 22)
	_interwave.visible = false
	_result.visible = false


func _panel_label(name_v: String, al: float, at: float, ar: float, ab: float,
		offsets: Vector4, font_size: int, accent: Color) -> Label:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.name = name_v
	panel.anchor_left = al
	panel.anchor_top = at
	panel.anchor_right = ar
	panel.anchor_bottom = ab
	panel.offset_left = offsets.x
	panel.offset_top = offsets.y
	panel.offset_right = offsets.z
	panel.offset_bottom = offsets.w
	panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = BG
	style.border_color = Color(accent, 0.58)
	style.set_border_width_all(1)
	style.content_margin_left = 12
	style.content_margin_right = 12
	style.content_margin_top = 8
	style.content_margin_bottom = 8
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	_root.add_child(panel)
	var label := Label.new()
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	panel.add_child(label)
	return label


func _center_overlay(name_v: String, size_v: Vector2, accent: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.name = name_v
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -size_v.x * 0.5
	panel.offset_top = -size_v.y * 0.5
	panel.offset_right = size_v.x * 0.5
	panel.offset_bottom = size_v.y * 0.5
	panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.018, 0.014, 0.01, 0.95)
	style.border_color = accent
	style.set_border_width_all(2)
	style.content_margin_left = 24
	style.content_margin_right = 24
	style.content_margin_top = 20
	style.content_margin_bottom = 20
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	_root.add_child(panel)
	return panel


func _overlay_label(panel: PanelContainer, font_size: int) -> Label:
	var label := Label.new()
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", AMBER)
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	panel.add_child(label)
	return label


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if _toast != null and Time.get_ticks_msec() > _toast_until_ms:
		_toast.text = ""


func _on_snapshot(s: Dictionary) -> void:
	if _player == null:
		return
	_minimap.update_state(s)

	var hp_pct := int(round(float(s.get("player_hp", 1.0)) * 100.0))
	var pstate := str(s.get("player_state", "on_foot")).to_upper()
	_player.text = "PILOT // %s\nHP %03d%%\nLMB FIRE  RMB AIM  SPACE JUMP" % [pstate, hp_pct]

	var wave := int(s.get("wave", 0))
	var wave_total := int(s.get("waves_total", 3))
	var phase := str(s.get("phase", "deploy")).to_upper()
	_wave.text = "WAVE %d/%d  //  %s" % [wave, wave_total, phase]

	var core_pct := int(round(float(s.get("core_hp", 0.0)) * 100.0))
	var ex := int(s.get("ex_current", 0))
	var quota := int(s.get("quota", 0))
	var risk := str(s.get("risk_state", "safe")).to_upper()
	_objective.text = "CORE %03d%%\nEX %d / %d\nRISK // %s" % [core_pct, ex, quota, risk]
	_objective.add_theme_color_override("font_color", ALERT if risk == "GREEDY" else INFO)

	var dens: Dictionary = s.get("threat_lanes", {})
	var next_lane := str(s.get("next_threat_lane", ""))
	var priority := str(s.get("priority_threat_lane", ""))
	_threat.text = "THREAT  A %s   B %s   C %s   // NEXT %s  PRIORITY %s" % [
		_meter(float(dens.get("A", 0.0))),
		_meter(float(dens.get("B", 0.0))),
		_meter(float(dens.get("C", 0.0))),
		next_lane if next_lane != "" else "--",
		priority if priority != "" else "--"]

	var mech_state := str(s.get("mech_state", "none")).to_upper()
	var mech_hp := int(round(float(s.get("mech_integrity", 1.0)) * 100.0))
	var supply := int(round(float(s.get("supply_state", 0.0)) * 100.0))
	var extract := "READY" if bool(s.get("extract_available", false)) else "LOCKED"
	var turret_summary := _turret_summary(s.get("turret_ammo_state", []))
	_systems.text = "MECH %s %03d%%\nSUPPLY %03d%%  // %s\nEXTRACT %s  // E AT PAD\nF SUPPLY  R RELOCATE  M MECH" % [
		mech_state, mech_hp, supply, turret_summary, extract]

	_interwave.visible = phase == "INTERWAVE"
	if _interwave.visible:
		_interwave_text.text = (
			"INTER-WAVE // CONTRACT CONTROL\n\n"+
			"NEXT THREAT: %s    CURRENT RISK: %s\n"+
			"ENTER — CONTINUE    G — SAFE/GREEDY    E — EXTRACT AT PAD\n\n"+
			"Quota reached: %s") % [
				next_lane if next_lane != "" else "PENDING",
				risk,
				"YES" if bool(s.get("extract_available", false)) else "NO"]

	var result_v = s.get("result", {})
	_result.visible = phase == "ENDED" or (result_v is Dictionary and not result_v.is_empty())
	if _result.visible:
		var outcome := "OPERATION COMPLETE"
		if result_v is Dictionary:
			outcome = str(result_v.get("outcome", result_v.get("result", outcome))).to_upper()
		_result_text.text = (
			"%s\n\nCORE %03d%%   EX %d / %d\n"+
			"SESSION COMPLETE // TELEMETRY SAVED TO user://logs") % [
			outcome, core_pct, ex, quota]


func _meter(v: float) -> String:
	var n := int(round(clampf(v, 0.0, 1.0) * 4.0))
	return "[" + "■".repeat(n) + "·".repeat(4 - n) + "]"


func _turret_summary(states_v) -> String:
	if not states_v is Array or states_v.is_empty():
		return "DEFENSE --"
	var parts: Array[String] = []
	for t in states_v:
		if not t is Dictionary:
			continue
		var ammo := int(t.get("ammo", 0))
		var cap := maxi(1, int(t.get("ammo_max", 1)))
		parts.append("%s %d%%" % [str(t.get("kind", "?")), int(round(100.0 * ammo / cap))])
	return "  ".join(parts) if not parts.is_empty() else "DEFENSE --"


func _on_gameplay_event(ename: StringName, payload: Dictionary) -> void:
	var msg := ""
	var color := AMBER
	match String(ename):
		"wave_started":
			msg = "WAVE COMMITTED // LANES %s" % str(payload.get("lanes", []))
		"core_damaged":
			msg = "CORE IMPACT // DEFENSE LIABILITY"
			color = ALERT
		"risk_changed":
			msg = "RISK PROFILE // %s" % str(payload.get("state", "safe")).to_upper()
		"quota_met":
			msg = "CONTRACT MINIMUM MET // EXTRACT OR CONTINUE"
			color = OK
		"harasser_lock":
			msg = "HARASSER LOCK // %s" % str(payload.get("target", "INFRA"))
			color = ALERT
		"harasser_strike":
			msg = "HARASSER STRIKE // %s" % str(payload.get("target", "INFRA"))
			color = ALERT
		"pilot_hit":
			msg = "PILOT HIT // %s" % str(payload.get("source_role", "ENEMY"))
			color = ALERT
		"pilot_down":
			msg = "PILOT DOWN"
			color = ALERT
		"hazard_started":
			msg = str(payload.get("hazard_id", "HAZARD")).replace("_", " ")
			color = ALERT
		"extraction_denied":
			msg = "EXTRACTION DENIED // REACH PAD"
			color = ALERT
		"mission_success":
			msg = "CONTRACT RESOLVED // SUCCESS"
			color = OK
		"mission_failed":
			msg = "CONTRACT RESOLVED // FAILURE"
			color = ALERT
		_:
			return
	_toast.text = msg
	_toast.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	_toast_until_ms = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 3200

## VS6 unit checks. Run:
##   godot --headless --path labs/mech --fixed-fps 60 --script res://tests/orchestrators/mech/run_tests.gd
## Exits 0 on PASS, 1 on FAIL. Assert-based, no framework.

const DT := 1.0 / 60.0

var fails: Array[String] = []
var total := 0


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run()


func _ok(cond: bool, name: String) -> void:
	total += 1
	if not cond:
		fails.append(name)
		print("  FAIL: ", name)


func _run() -> void:
	await process_frame
	seed(1234)
	var world := Node3D.new()
	root.add_child(world)
	var kit := SimKit.assemble(world)

	print("T1 interface")
	_test_interface(world)

	print("T1 interface")
	_test_interface(world)

	var handling_result: Array = await HandlingTests.run(self, world, kit)
	total += HandlingTests.total_borrowed
	fails.append_array(handling_result)
	if HandlingTests.total_borrowed < HandlingTests.EXPECTED_CHECKS:
		var skipped := HandlingTests.EXPECTED_CHECKS - HandlingTests.total_borrowed
		fails.append("HandlingTests ABORTED early: %d checks silently skipped" % skipped)
		total += skipped

	var weapons_result: Array = await WeaponsFlowTests.run(self, world, kit)
	total += WeaponsFlowTests.total_borrowed
	fails.append_array(weapons_result)
	if WeaponsFlowTests.total_borrowed < WeaponsFlowTests.EXPECTED_CHECKS:
		var skipped2 := WeaponsFlowTests.EXPECTED_CHECKS - WeaponsFlowTests.total_borrowed
		fails.append("WeaponsFlowTests ABORTED early: %d checks silently skipped" % skipped2)
		total += skipped2

	# The headless Dummy audio backend releases active WAV playbacks a few process
	# turns after the synthetic world is destroyed. Tear down before quit so the
	# suite proves clean ObjectDB ownership rather than exiting with false leaks.
	world.free()
	for _i in range(12):
		await process_frame

	print("")
	if fails.is_empty():
		print("ALL %d CHECKS PASSED" % total)
		quit(0)
	else:
		print("%d/%d CHECKS FAILED:" % [fails.size(), total])
		for f in fails:
			print("  - ", f)
		quit(1)


func frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n):
		await physics_frame


func _test_interface(world: Node3D) -> void:
	var cmd := ActorIface.make_command(Vector2(1, -1), Vector2(0.5, 0), true, true, false, true)
	for k in ["mv", "look", "jump", "fire_p", "fire_s", "interact"]:
		_ok(cmd.has(k), "command has key %s" % k)
	var reqs: Array = ActorIface.weapon_requests(cmd)
	_ok(reqs.size() == 1 and reqs[0]["slot"] == "primary", "weapon_requests primary only")
	var reqs2: Array = ActorIface.weapon_requests(
			ActorIface.make_command(Vector2.ZERO, Vector2.ZERO, false, true, true))
	_ok(reqs2.size() == 2, "weapon_requests both slots")

	var hnode := Health.new()
	world.add_child(hnode)
	var states: Array = []
	hnode.state_changed.connect(func(s: int) -> void: states.append(s))
	var died_flag := [false]
	hnode.destroyed.connect(func(_e: Dictionary) -> void: died_flag[0] = true)
	ActorIface.apply_damage(hnode, ActorIface.make_damage(30))
	ActorIface.apply_damage(hnode, ActorIface.make_damage(30))   # 40% -> DAMAGED
	ActorIface.apply_damage(hnode, ActorIface.make_damage(20))   # 20% -> CRITICAL
	ActorIface.apply_damage(hnode, ActorIface.make_damage(25))   # dead
	_ok(hnode.state == ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED, "health destroyed state")
	_ok(died_flag[0], "destroyed signal emitted")
	_ok(states == [ActorIface.ActorState.DAMAGED, ActorIface.ActorState.CRITICAL,
			ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED], "state ladder order")

func test_midwave_replan_never_drops_or_rerolls_pending_batches() -> void:
	var cfg := MissionLoader.load_canonical()
	var safe: Dictionary = {}
	var greedy: Dictionary = {}
	for p in cfg.get("risk", {}).get("profiles", []):
		if str(p.get("id", "")) == "SAFE":
			safe = p
		elif str(p.get("id", "")) == "GREEDY":
			greedy = p
	var wave: Dictionary = cfg.get("waves", [])[0]
	var plan := WavePlanner.plan_wave(wave, safe, int(cfg.meta.seed), 1, 0)
	var now := 250
	var old_pending := WavePlanner.pending_batches(plan, now + 1)
	var greedy_plan := WavePlanner.retime_pending(plan, wave, greedy, now)
	ok(greedy_plan.batches.size() == old_pending.size(),
		"SAFE->GREEDY keeps every not-yet-emitted batch")
	var by_id := {}
	for b in old_pending:
		by_id[str(b.batch_id)] = b
	for b in greedy_plan.batches:
		var old: Dictionary = by_id.get(str(b.batch_id), {})
		ok(not old.is_empty(), "replan preserves authored batch identity")
		ok(str(b.role) == str(old.role) and int(b.count) == int(old.count),
			"replan does not reroll role/count")
		ok(int(b.at_step) > now, "replan never schedules a pending batch in the past")
		ok(int(b.at_step) <= int(old.at_step), "GREEDY may accelerate but never drop by stale time")
	var safe_again := WavePlanner.retime_pending(greedy_plan, wave, safe, now)
	var greedy_again := WavePlanner.retime_pending(safe_again, wave, greedy, now)
	ok(JSON.stringify(safe_again.batches) == JSON.stringify(greedy_again.batches),
		"SAFE/GREEDY toggling cannot reroll or repeatedly compress committed threats")

func test_crowd_snapshot_transport_stays_below_unreliable_mtu() -> void:
	var sim := CrowdSim.new(150, 20260829, OperationLayout.GRID_W,
		OperationLayout.GRID_H, OperationLayout.CROWD_CELL)
	sim.configure_navigation(OperationNav.build_field(false),
		OperationNav.core_cell(), OperationNav.lane_cells(false))
	sim.begin_wave(150, 0.01)
	for _i in 4:
		sim.step(1.0 / 60.0)
	var snapshot := EnemySnapshotCodec.encode(sim, 150)
	ok(snapshot.size() > CrowdStream.SNAPSHOT_RPC_PAYLOAD_MAX,
		"150-agent HSNP exercises chunked transport")
	var chunks := CrowdStream.split_snapshot_bytes(snapshot)
	ok(chunks.size() >= 2 and chunks.size() <= CrowdStream.MAX_SNAPSHOT_CHUNKS,
		"large HSNP splits into a bounded chunk count")
	for chunk_v in chunks:
		var chunk := chunk_v as PackedByteArray
		ok(chunk.size() <= CrowdStream.SNAPSHOT_RPC_PAYLOAD_MAX,
			"every unreliable RPC payload stays under transport ceiling")
	var rebuilt := CrowdStream.join_snapshot_chunks(chunks)
	ok(rebuilt == snapshot, "chunked HSNP reassembles byte-exactly")
	var decoded := EnemySnapshotCodec.decode(rebuilt)
	ok(not decoded.is_empty() and decoded.uid.size() == 150,
		"reassembled 150-agent HSNP decodes without semantic loss")
